slides.headline: What an extra IPv4 costs
slides.caption: One extra IPv4 is its own line item: sixty cents a month at Hetzner, two dollars forty at OVHcloud, five dollars at DigitalOcean.

slides.headline: Three published prices
slides.caption: All three include the first address with the server. Between sixty cents and five dollars the spread is eight point three times.

slides.headline: Assigned is free, parked is $5.00
slides.caption: DigitalOcean's five dollars applies only when the address is unassigned. Attached to a Droplet it costs nothing; parked, a penny an hour up to five dollars.

slides.kicker: THE MONTHLY PRICE IS NOT A MONTH
slides.headline: 500, 600 and 625 hours
slides.caption: Divide monthly by hourly and the caps land at five hundred hours at DigitalOcean, six hundred at Hetzner in dollars, six hundred twenty-five in euros.

slides.kicker: ONE ADDRESS AS A SHARE OF THE SERVER
slides.headline: 125% and 52.9%
slides.caption: A parked address is one hundred twenty-five percent of DigitalOcean's four-dollar Droplet; OVHcloud's two forty is fifty-two point nine percent of a four fifty-four server.

slides.headline: 16 addresses, $38.40, 8.46x
slides.caption: Sixteen addresses at OVHcloud is thirty-eight forty a month, eight point four six times the server. Powering off changes none of it.
